notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517371/8ecb34cc8d2f2fe313928a97ee0ac3404a1fc880.png"][/img][/p][p]The first small update for Aggi's Tiny Friends is out now! Adding more variety to your creations with a ton of new googly eye designs which is determined by the design of your cell![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="r_SFdNVTl58;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]This is hopefully going to be the first of many updates, but unless this game gets a lot more sales, the development of this project will remain as a hobby for me so new updates may be slow.[/p][p][/p][p]Follow me on Bluesky for updates on all my games: [url="https://bsky.app/profile/autumnlavender.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/autumnlavender.bsky.social[/url][/p][p]Thanks everyone so much for playing![/p]
